description: A booking platform built around multi-role reservations, partial payments, and host/guest workflows.
highlights: Architected and implemented a robust booking system handling partial payments and complex multi-role authorization logic (Host, User, Admin).
Designed and engineered a fully serverless, highly-available backend on Cloudflare using Hono, Turso, and Drizzle ORM.
Implemented robust security policies, including strict cookie handling, edge-level DDoS protection via Cloudflare, and privacy-safe external API integrations.
Integrated enterprise tooling including Better-Auth for identity, PostHog for product analytics, and Sanity CMS for blog content delivery.
